neighbours.label: a predicate reporting a statistical link in research (has been linked to, associated with, tend to)
fire: Smoking has been linked to cancer in many large studies.
High blood pressure is associated with stroke in older adults.
Lack of sleep has been linked to weight gain in teens.
Anxiety is associated with poor grades among first-year students.
Air pollution has been linked to asthma in children.
Older mothers tend to have fewer complications in these trials.
Stress has been linked to heart disease in this cohort.
Low income is associated with shorter lives in most regions.
quiet: Smoking has been banned in many large buildings.
High fences are built along the road for older adults.
Lack of sleep made me late for work today.
Anxiety kept me awake during the first-year exam.
Air travel has been cheap for families with children.
Older mothers came to the meeting at the school.
Stress kept him at home during this week.
Low clouds moved over the hills in most regions.

notes: Card flags broad (1.4%): '.' x6, ' found' x2, ',' x2, ' similar', ' associated', ' linked'. Probes weak: ' linked' 0.277, ' associated' 0.101, ' be' 0.091, ' found' 0.085. May fail on the median.
